The [`apps/`](https://github.com/calimero-network/core/tree/master/apps)
directory of core is the ground truth for writing an app: every example is a
real `calimero-sdk` crate, built into a `wasm32-wasip2` component by
`calimero-app-build` and tested on `TestApp` and its `scenarios/*.json`
([Testing](/build/testing/)). Each is a standalone crate, so it builds and
tests on its own:

```bash
cargo test --manifest-path apps/kv-store/Cargo.toml
```

Each follows the same shape ([SDK macros](/build/sdk-macros/)): one
`#[app::state]` struct of [tables and collections](/build/collections/),
an `#[app::logic]` impl with an `#[app::init]`, calls and views, and optionally
`#[app::error]` and `#[app::event]` enums. Read the state struct first: it says
which reads and writes are cheap.

## Start here

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `kv-store` | The basic example: a string key-value store on an `UnorderedMap`, events, views, a typed error; harness tests, scenarios, and a migration scenario against its shipped `releases/0.1.0.mpk`. |
| `kv-store-init` | An `init` that seeds entries. |
| `sorted-kv-store` | Ordered reads on a map: `range`, `prefix`, `page`, `first`, `last`. |
| `sorted-set-store` | The same on a `Set`. |
| `custom-key-store` | A newtype slug as a map key (`ToKey` / `FromKey`). |
| `team-metrics` | Per-team `Counter`s and a badge bitmask. |

## Tables

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `indexed-issue-tracker` | List views that are index seeks: `#[table(index(..), count(..))]`, `find`, `count`. |
| `indexed-forum` | Threads and posts on tables with indexes and counts. |
| `rooms` | The reference app: bookings with a unique slot, timers, confirm, public methods. |

## Access control

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `org-gated` | Members read, admins write, a team writes its own note (`guards`, `env::in_team`). |
| `permissions-showcase` | One write rule per record kind: write-once, moderated, author-keyed, content-addressed. |
| `kv-store-with-user-and-frozen-storage` | `PerUser` values and content-addressed `Frozen` values. |
| `kv-store-with-shared-storage` | A key-value store guarded by writer sets. |
| `authored-sorted-kv-store` | A noticeboard with per-note authors and topic slices. |
| `name-registry-admin` | Usernames: one owner per name, decided by the admins. |
| `components-demo` | An owned cell, a writer set and a role registry. |

See [Access control](/build/guides/access-control/) for the patterns.

## Compute

| App | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `compute-redact` | `#[app::compute]` runs over sealed CSV files: a preview, then one run per part, at most 4 active; the compute component (`mero-app-build --compute-out`); `compute::publish` and a grant link. See [Compute actions](/build/guides/compute-actions/). |

## Fixtures

`apps/v2-fixtures/` holds the small apps the node's own tests run. The name is
historical (they were the fixtures of the component SDK while SDK 0.12 still
ran); they are ordinary `calimero-sdk` apps.

| Fixture | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `kv` | Calls, views, a `confirm` method, files, blobs, xcalls, actions and timers; also the `kv-store-test-fixture.mpk` attached to core's releases, which the clients' tests install |
| `compute` | Compute methods that stream files, report progress and break each cap (`mero-compute`'s tests, the job-node tests) |
| `captcha` | A captcha service other apps of the organization verify against in the same request (`env::xcall_call`), and a Cloudflare Turnstile check with `env::fetch` |
| `files` | Deterministic files written from calls and kept by `BlobRef`, and the refusal to stream them back outside a compute run |
| `org-gated` | Org roles and teams on a cluster |
| `notes-v1`, `notes-v2` | Two releases of one app, for the consent page's upgrade diff |
